# Additional forecast source PDFs

Official PDFs for eight of the thirteen oversized amount rows left unresolved in the
2026-10-28 initial audit. Each file is named by ticker; its URL and SHA-256
are recorded in `tests/test_forecast_additional_real_pdfs.py`. All five
forecast columns were checked against the source table. These fixtures do not
by themselves authorize a production repair.
